1.web: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
1.asv: A wise sonhearethhis father’s instruction; But a scoffer heareth not rebuke.

2.web: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things; but the unfaithful crave violence.
2.asv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; But the soul of the treacherousshall eatviolence.

3.web: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
3.asv: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; Buthe that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

4.web: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
4.asv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

5.web: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
5.asv: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

6.web: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
6.asv: Righteousness guardeth him that is upright in the way; But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

7.web: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
7.asv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: There is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great wealth.

8.web: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
8.asv: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.

9.web: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
9.asv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth; But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

10.web: Pride only breeds quarrels, but with ones who take advice is wisdom.
10.asv: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.

11.web: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
11.asv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.

12.web: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
12.asv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

13.web: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
13.asv: Whoso despiseth the word bringeth destruction on himself; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

14.web: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
14.asv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.

15.web: Good understanding wins favor; but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
15.asv: Good understanding giveth favor; But the way of the transgressor is hard.

16.web: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
16.asv: Every prudent man worketh with knowledge; But a fool flaunteth his folly.

17.web: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
17.asv: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.

18.web: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
18.asv: Poverty and shameshall be tohim that refuseth correction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honored.

19.web: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
19.asv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.

20.web: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
20.asv: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.

21.web: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
21.asv: Evil pursueth sinners; But the righteous shall be recompensed with good.

22.web: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
22.asv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children; And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous.

23.web: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
23.asv: Much foodis inthe tillage of the poor; But there is that is destroyed by reason of injustice.

24.web: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
24.asv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

25.web: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
25.asv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul; But the belly of the wicked shall want.
